title: Unable to accelerate or explain issue
summary: The sampled fragments center on unresolved inability-to-use or inability-to-explain situations, including acceleration, app features, and missing detail about the underlying problem.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe customers being unable to accelerate, use connected app features, complete pairing steps, or provide or receive an explanation of the issue.

limitations: All sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so no known sentiment can be summarized beyond the reported inability or lack of explanation.
The cluster mixes unrelated subjects such as acceleration, FaceTime, remote app functions, pairing constraints, and limited issue descriptions.
Several fragments are too brief to identify root cause, severity, or whether the issue was resolved.
